title: QR codes

createPage.title: New QR code
createPage.description: Point it at any URL. You'll pick colours, shapes and a logo next, and you can change the destination after printing.
createPage.titleHint: Optional. Helps you find the code later.

viewerReason: Viewers can't create or change QR codes. Ask a workspace admin to change your role.

delete.title: Delete {count, plural, one {# QR code} other {# QR codes}}?
delete.body: Printed copies stop scanning, because each code's short link is deleted with it. This can't be undone.
delete.confirm: Delete {count, plural, one {# QR code} other {# QR codes}}
delete.done: Deleted {count, plural, one {# QR code} other {# QR codes}}

empty.firstBody: Create a code for any URL. Each code gets its own short link, so you can change where it goes after it's printed.
empty.firstBodyViewer: QR codes created in this workspace appear here.
empty.noMatchBody: Check the spelling or clear the search.

error.title: QR codes didn't load
error.body: Your codes are safe; this is a connection problem. Try again in a moment.

errors.invalidUrl: Enter a full URL, like https://example.com/page.
errors.unsafeDestination: This destination can't be used. It points to a private or unsafe address.
errors.limitReached: You've created all {limit} QR codes your plan includes this month.
errors.forbidden: You don't have permission to do this in this workspace.
errors.notFound: This QR code no longer exists. It may have been deleted.
errors.invalidInput: Some fields are too long or not valid. Check them and try again.
errors.network: Couldn't reach Shortn. Check your connection and try again.
errors.generic: Something went wrong on our side. Try again.
errors.urlRequired: Enter the URL the code should open.
errors.logoUrl: Enter the logo's full URL, starting with https://.
errors.color: Every colour needs a value of up to 32 characters, like #0f172b.

content.title: Content
content.description: Where the code leads. The pattern never changes, so printed copies follow a new destination.
content.applyToLinkHint: Copies a new destination or title to the link this code is attached to.

pattern.title: Pattern
pattern.description: Shapes change the look; the link inside stays the same.

errorLevel.title: Error correction
errorLevel.description: Higher levels let a code survive scuffs and a logo, at the cost of a denser pattern.
errorLevel.label: Level

logo.title: Logo
logo.description: Drawn in the middle of the code.
logo.urlHint: A PNG, JPEG or SVG on a server that allows cross-origin requests.
logo.sizeHint: How much of the error correction the logo takes up. Keep it at 50% or less.
logo.hideDots: Hide the pattern behind the logo
logo.gatedExisting: Your plan no longer includes logos. You can keep this one or remove it.

check.title: Scan check
check.contrastOk: Good contrast ({value}). Phones read it easily.
check.contrastLow: Low contrast ({value}). Test it with a few phones before printing.
check.contrastFail: Too little contrast ({value}). Many phones won't read it: darken the code or lighten the background.
check.unknownColor: These colours can't be checked automatically. Test the code before printing.
check.inverted: Light code on a dark background. Some older scanner apps can't read inverted codes.
check.transparent: The background is see-through, so contrast depends on what it's printed on.
check.logoLarge: The logo takes up {value} of the error correction. Keep it at 50% or less so a scuffed print still reads.
check.logoSmall: With error correction L or M the logo is drawn small. Choose Q or H for a larger logo.
check.logoUnavailable: The logo didn't load, so the preview leaves it out. Check the URL and that its server allows cross-origin requests.

download.label: Download
download.logoFailed: The logo couldn't be loaded, so the download would be missing it.
